items.caption: A modern rendering of 問 in Shuowen seal-script style. The received analysis assigns 口 a meaning role and 門 a sound role, though the compared readings do not independently establish their historical sound correspondence.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style 問: two tall outer strokes enclose a central 口-like form, with two smaller enclosed openings near the top.
items.selection_reason: This legible rendering illustrates the received Shuowen form and component analysis; it does not establish a lineage from the disputed Shang graphs.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an excavated artifact. The identity and relationship to 問 of the Shang graphs combining 門 and 口 remain disputed; a proposed identification as expanded forms of 啟 is tentative.
